forum.title: Vulkan driver bug when running PPSSPP on STM32MP257D
forum.category: STM32 MPUs Embedded software and solutions
forum.best_answer_content: All issues stem from Weston. Run pkill weston to kill the process, then set the environment variable export SDL\_VIDEODRIVER=kmsdrm. You will also need to recompile the SDL library with kmsdrm support enabled. Screen tearing is completely resolved this way, and PPSSPP runs perfectly smoothly.
forum.author: zhangtinglu
